about: An open-source office suite for documents, sheets and slides, with a command-line tool.

prs.title: Nested Word lists stay nested when converted
prs.broken: Sub-items of a Word list came out as top-level items in HTML and Markdown, so a converted document lost its outline.
prs.changed: Items at a deeper list level are now written as a list nested inside their parent item.
prs.matters: Documents keep their structure when converted to Markdown or read back.
